verdict.rationale: The evidence pack points to a first-party server-side support page and a NullEngine class reference, which indicates Babylon.js has its own documented headless, non-rendering engine path for running scene and game logic on servers. However, the pack contains only the page sources, not their content, so the depth and limits of the server runtime are unproven. Missing for 10: documented details of what runs headless (physics, animations, asset loading) under NullEngine, Node.js dedicated-server setup guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a game developer, game logic runs headless on servers — a dedicated-server or server-runtime build without rendering
